endpoints.summary: Gets information about a file.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token. Requires scope: `files:read`

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Specify a file by providing its ID.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return. Fewer than the requested number of items may be returned, even if the end of the list hasn't been reached.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Parameter for pagination. File comments are paginated for a single file. Set `cursor` equal to the `next_cursor` attribute returned by the previous request's `response_metadata`. This parameter is optional, but pagination is mandatory: the default value simply fetches the first "page" of the collection of comments. See [pagination](/docs/pagination) for more details.

endpoints.summary: List for a team, in a channel, or from a user with applied filters.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token. Requires scope: `files:read`

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: Filter files created by a single user.

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Filter files appearing in a specific channel, indicated by its ID.

parameters.name: ts_from
parameters.description: Filter files created after this timestamp (inclusive).

parameters.name: ts_to
parameters.description: Filter files created before this timestamp (inclusive).

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Filter files by type ([see below](#file_types)). You can pass multiple values in the types argument, like `types=spaces,snippets`.The default value is `all`, which does not filter the list.

parameters.name: show_files_hidden_by_limit
parameters.description: Show truncated file info for files hidden due to being too old, and the team who owns the file being over the file limit.

This parameter is optional, but pagination is mandatory: the default value simply fetches the first "page" of the collection. See [pagination](/docs/pagination) for more details.

parameters.name: limit

endpoints.summary: Lists all users in a Slack team.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Authentication token. Requires scope: `users:read`

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return. Fewer than the requested number of items may be returned, even if the end of the users list hasn't been reached. Providing no `limit` value will result in Slack attempting to deliver you the entire result set. If the collection is too large you may experience `limit_required` or HTTP 500 errors.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paginate through collections of data by setting the `cursor` parameter to a `next_cursor` attribute returned by a previous request's `response_metadata`. Default value fetches the first "page" of the collection. See [pagination](/docs/pagination) for more detail.

parameters.name: include_locale
parameters.description: Set this to `true` to receive the locale for users. Defaults to `false`
